name: Rose Sharbat
description: A fragrant chilled drink of rose syrup, milk or water, and basil seeds, poured over ice for a floral refresher.
ingredients: a handful of fresh curry leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine the basmati rice and whole milk in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the garam masala and roasted cashews, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with lemon wedges, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
